summary: Iteration 14 full-app investor-grade regression: 6-role demo-login + entire sidebar link matrix (77 routes across 6 roles) + backend endpoint contract + rebrand check. Backend pytest: 35/35 pass. Frontend Playwright: 76/77 routes render cleanly. ONE real bug found: Provider /profile page crashes with React error 'Objects are not valid as a React child (found: object with keys {l, v})' due to a JSX ternary-precedence bug in /app/frontend/src/pages/client/Profile.jsx (lines 62-79). Rebrand is clean: <title> = 'Pro Finder NZ — Trusted Home Services Marketplace', zero 'dispatchr' text visible in body. 404 fallback ('/does-not-exist' -> user's dashboard via '/') works. No 500 responses anywhere. Only 401s on /api/auth/me pre-login (expected).

ui_bugs.component: Profile (shared /profile page rendered for Provider role)
ui_bugs.issue: React render crash: 'Objects are not valid as a React child (found: object with keys {l, v})'. Root cause: JSX ternary precedence bug at lines 62-79 of /app/frontend/src/pages/client/Profile.jsx — the `.map(...)` only binds to the else-branch array, so when isProvider===true, React attempts to render the raw array of `{l,v}` objects. Fix: wrap the ternary in parentheses so both arrays are mapped, e.g. `{(isProvider ? [...] : [...]).map((s) => (...))}`.

critical_code_review_comments: server.py POST /api/jobs validates category/subcategory using slug-based index keys, but the public GET /api/services/taxonomy/{service_type} returns human-readable names. The frontend picker must be sending slugs (works in tests), but this dual naming is a maintenance risk — consider accepting either name or slug and normalising server-side.

There is no /api/services/taxonomy (bare) endpoint — only /api/services/taxonomy/{service_type}. Anyone hitting the bare path gets 404. Consider adding a bare-path alias returning both residential+commercial for convenience.

Profile.jsx uses the SAME component for customer and provider — the provider profile is functionally a stripped-down customer profile. Consider a dedicated ProviderProfile page (or role-aware fields) so provider-specific data like verification, portfolio, rating, service radius can be surfaced.
RootRoute + catch-all `<Route path='*' element={<Navigate to='/' replace />} />` means fake routes silently redirect for authed users; consider a proper 404 page for a more polished investor demo.

rca of the issue: Provider /profile crash — RCA: In /app/frontend/src/pages/client/Profile.jsx the stat-tile block is written as `{isProvider ? [{l,v},...] : [{l,v},...].map(s => <div/>)}`. JavaScript operator precedence binds `.map` to the else-side array only. When isProvider===true, React receives the true-branch array of plain objects and throws 'Objects are not valid as a React child (found: object with keys {l, v})'. Reproduction: log in as demo-provider@profinder.nz -> navigate to /profile -> full-page blank + red pageerror in console. Mitigation: `{(isProvider ? A : B).map(...)}` — wrap the ternary in parens so `.map` applies to whichever branch is chosen.
